name: Vesper Gate
description: A hospice and retreat station beyond Green Meridian; dim corridors, a chapel that doubles as a dock lounge, and a market that mostly sells what the sick need.
character: Vesper Gate is wardens, physicians and the people who came to sit with someone and stayed: pilgrims, mourners, a few who took vows and a few who are only hiding. They want quiet, respect for the dying, and ships that leave on time and do not make a fuss. The Gate is known for its hospice, for funerals held in the long gallery with the viewport open, and for making the best medical kits on the lanes.

castSeed.name: Sister Aurelie Doucet
castSeed.note: Calm, dry, and the person who decides whether a visitor is let in; she has seen every kind of grief and is unimpressed by drama.

castSeed.name: Jonah Weir
castSeed.note: Meets every ship himself, remembers every passenger's name, and keeps a list of the ones who never came back for a second visit.

castSeed.name: Dr. Imke Rasmussen
castSeed.note: Runs the clinic and the med-kit workshop, blunt about prognoses, and always short of parts for her autoclaves.
